title: Charge on Plastic Bags at Supermarkets
what_it_is: Charge on Plastic Bags at Supermarkets

sections.label: ZeroWasteSG supermarket shopper survey
sections.summary: ZeroWasteSG's survey of supermarket shoppers found only 15% used reusable bags or trolleys without taking plastic bags.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For instance, ZeroWasteSG conducted a survey among supermarket shoppers and found that only 15% of shoppers were using reusable bags or trolleys without taking plastic bags.

sections.label: NEA plastic bag study tender
sections.summary: The Ministry and NEA are studying survey responses, engaging supermarket operators, and published a tender on single-use carriers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: My Ministry and the National Environment Agency (NEA) are looking into the responses to ZeroWasteSG's survey and are engaging supermarket operators to explore potential solutions to reduce the excessive use of plastic bags.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: NEA has also recently published a tender to study the different types of single-use carriers and how they compare in terms of cost and impact on the environment.

sections.label: Survey charge and timeframe questions
sections.summary: The question asks about a decision timeframe and whether the Ministry will consider survey findings on a 10-cent charge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But is there a timeframe before a decision is going to be made?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But can the Ministry also consider the other part of the survey which showed that 65% of shoppers would reduce the number of plastic bags they take from supermarkets, or 58% would actually bring their own reusable bag if there is a 10-cent charge that is imposed by the supermarkets?

sections.label: Plastic bags incinerated not landfilled
sections.summary: Discarded plastic bags, together with municipal waste, are incinerated and not directly landfilled.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Together with the municipal waste, the plastic bags which are thrown away are actually incinerated and not directly landfilled.

sections.label: Stakeholder engagement and life cycle study
sections.summary: The Ministry is engaging stakeholders, studying other countries and a life cycle assessment to formulate plastic bag policies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We need to engage the stakeholders which we are doing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are also looking at the experiences of other countries, as well as a life cycle assessment study that we are conducting, which will look at the cost and environmental impact on the different types of bags used.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This will help us to formulate policies, including on the use of plastic bags.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I think we need to do this in order to come to a decision and we will share with Members the results and outcome of our studies and the decision on whether to implement a charge on plastic bags.

sections.label: Biodegradable bag incineration emissions study
sections.summary: A tender was published and a Life Cycle Assessment commissioned on single carrier bags and food and beverage containers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can I confirm if the Ministry has done a study with regard to the emissions from a biodegradable plastic bag when incinerated as opposed to one which is not bio-degradable?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have recently published a tender and we have commissioned a study – Life Cycle Assessment – on the different types of single carrier bags used, as well as common forms of containers that are used for food and beverage.
